strategic_architecture: Solo-commander toolbox/combo archetype. Sisay tutors legendary permanents onto the battlefield once you can produce one mana of each color, giving access to a wide combo toolbox (Dockside Extortionist + Emiel the Blessed for infinite mana; falls back to Thassa's Oracle + Tainted Pact/Demonic Consultation, or Displacer Kitten loops, if the primary line is answered). Notably resilient to single-point interaction because of the toolbox redundancy - relevant to this project's own Phase 6 H6 hypothesis about difficult opponents. Sources: Commander's Herald 'An Introduction to Sisay in cEDH', Draftsim, Learn cEDH.
